पृच् {vI.v} {c2c} A. (पृक्ते, पृक्ण) To come
in contact with. {vII.v} {c7c} P. (पृणक्ति,
पृक्त)
1 To bring into contact with,
join, unite; एवं वदन्
दाशरथिरपृणग्धनुषा शरं

.
--2 To mix,
mingle.
--3 To be in contact with, touch.
--4 To satisfy, fill, satiate.
--5 To
augment, increase.
--6 Ved To give or
grant bountifully. {vIII.v} {c1c} P.,
{c10c} U. (पर्चति, पर्चयति-ते)
1 To touch
come in contact with.
--2 To hinder
oppose.

पृच्छकः [प्रच्छ्-ण्वुल् संप्रसारणं] An
[]
inquirer, an investigator; पृच्छकेन
सदा भाव्यं पुरुषेण विजानता

1 Questioning, asking,
inquiring.
--2 An inquiry into the future.
